_doc: ORDER-836 B2 body tide. Read only by systems/BodyTide.gd. In a full run, a choice listed here sets the body's weekly tide for `weeks` weeks after the week it was chosen: rest adds health, strain takes it, on top of the automatic routine. The latest listed choice replaces the earlier tide. A full-run monthly health crisis still hits at once with its toast and queues one crisis scene for the next free week (the first not yet used, then the oldest), so the player can answer the body. Values are [첫 실행 재조정].
